Title: Open a savings account online
Preconditions: The applicant has a valid email address

Title: Open a savings account online
Action: Enter the applicant's name, date of birth and address.

Title: Reject an applicant under 18
Action: Make sure the applicant is 17 years old.

Title: Reject an applicant under 18
Action: Enter the date of birth and tap Submit.
Expected Result:
1. The message "Applicants must be 18 or older" is displayed.
2. No account is created.

Title: Verify the email address
Expected Result: The email contains a verification link.
